Glance 2026.07.25.1 is a hotfix release for preview opening and Markdown rendering.

## Hotfix

- Prevent black title and status bars from flashing when the preview window opens.
- Prevent stale WebView2 content from flashing while reopening or switching Markdown previews.
- Reduce Markdown preview latency and improve README rendering with GitHub-style layout, relative images, and embedded HTML.

## Release contents

- `Glance-Setup-2026.07.25.1-x64.exe`: Recommended installer containing the core application and selectable optional components. All components are selected by default.
- `Glance-2026.07.25.1-x64.zip`: Portable core application without optional components.
- `Glance-Component-<Name>-2026.07.25.1-x64.zip`: Standalone optional component. Use only the package from the same Glance release, extract it into the application's `components` directory, and restart Glance.
- `Glance-2026.07.25.1-x64-symbols.zip`: Debug symbols for diagnostics and crash analysis.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for every release asset.
